decision.summary: A rapid, multi-sample shift occurs at indices ~610–615 across all axes (N, E, U), with values dropping sharply and remaining negative/offset through index 624. No clear return to pre-shift levels is observed within the allowed context [570,729]; later samples show continued variability without recovery. The onset is abrupt, interior is sustained and variable, but the absence of a confirmed opposing return prevents confirmation of a temporary offset. One candidate jump at index 618 aligns with the transition but does not resolve the return ambiguity.

intervals.observation: Abrupt multi-axis drop in N/E/U beginning ~610–615 (e.g., N: ~1.6→−5.2, E: ~2.3→−1.6, U: ~6.1→−0.5), sustained through index 624 with no return; interior shows high variability but remains offset from pre-event levels. Return not observed within allowed context.
